task: Clarified Owner Intervention and Expertise Authority
resolution: Added explicit rules in AGENT_RULES.md and strategy.md stating that the Owner retains the full right to override or intervene in details of any workflow pipeline step where they possess specific expertise.
lessons_learned: Explicitly documenting the boundaries of Owner authority prevents friction during agent workflow executions.

task: Memos Giant Steps: Proposal Validation and Roadmap Triage
hurdles_regression: Ensuring proposal records can be validated without bringing in full JSONSchema python library dependencies or modifying active database connections.
resolution: Implemented lightweight, native field validation matching the JSON Schema rules directly in python inside validate_memory.py, and integrated the checks into both validating and auditing CLI loops.
lessons_learned: When designing lightweight configuration or inbox contracts, native python validation checks avoid the overhead of heavy external package installations while keeping runtime checks robust.

hurdles_regression: Integrating a scheduler cadence without introducing background worker overhead or unapproved API/token consumption, while still allowing operators to manually generate review proposals.
resolution: Implemented the POST /api/analytics/data-methods/proposals admin-gated REST API endpoint that triggers manual proposals generation and records them directly to the proposals file and memory lifecycle events. Integrated a new Proposals trigger button on the Operator panel, wired it via a UI spinner action to retrieve data, updated the global roadmap, and rebuilt the memory snapshot.
lessons_learned: Using explicit, manual dashboard actions (Option S1) allows scheduling checks without the CPU and token consumption risks associated with automatic background cron jobs or daemon processes.

task: Memory OS Knowledge Compaction & Graph Extraction
hurdles_regression: Processing a large backlog of uncompacted capsules (e.g., 47 rows) in a single LLM invocation causes token limit truncation and invalid JSON. Reciprocal incremental nodes also need to be accessible in intermediate batch loops.
resolution: Implemented batching (10 capsules/batch) and appended new draft nodes to nodes.jsonl incrementally per batch. Updated lifecycle transition validation to support connector, config, and policy types.
lessons_learned: Batching capsule logs prevents token truncation issues. Appending intermediate nodes to nodes.jsonl dynamically allows subsequent batches to discover and link them incrementally.

task: Memory OS Dual-Purpose Architecture & Language Gating
hurdles_regression: Ensuring prompt updates in both English and Ukrainian enforce the exact Russian exception rules without breaking parser formats.
resolution: Refined strategy.md, memory_os_architecture.md, and AGENT_RULES.md to strictly separate Developer Memory OS from User-Facing Memory OS. Added Global Language Policy instructions to system prompts and agent rules, blocking Russian generation and gating responses based on user language.
lessons_learned: Strict database-level isolation of Developer Memory OS from end-user memory avoids accidental leaks of codebase architecture to user chats. Gating instructions should be synchronized across all core prompts.
